decisions.reason: The definition treated suspension and cofiber connecting maps as independent data, so exactness and naturality did not fix their relative sign. Davis–Kirk instead derive the long cofiber sequence from three-term exactness and suspension. Requiring partial_f=sigma_n(X)^{-1}(q_f)_* restores that essential compatibility.

The fixed-diagonal tower pairing is valid, but independently chosen cellular diagonal approximations need not commute with an arbitrary cellular map, and the E1 product can detect that failure. The carrier now limits E1 naturality to strictly compatible filtered diagonals while retaining natural cup products from E2 onward.

The Euler-square clause quantified over an arbitrary oriented real bundle, although the Euler and Whitney-product supplier requires numerable bundles. Requiring V to be numerable and observing that its complexification, realification and direct sum use the same numerated trivializing cover makes every Euler class and the product formula licensed.

For n=1 the former odd-dimensional argument referred to d_1 and E_1, although the supplied AHSS begins on E_2. The missing case is now proved directly: every allowed differential has r at least two and therefore exits the only supported columns 0 and 1.

This library explicitly treats the empty space as path-connected, while the cited Pontryagin stability theorem requires a nonempty base. The characteristic-class calculation is unchanged after adding the missing nonempty hypothesis, so the defect is a local scope omission rather than a failure of the stability identities.

For odd projective dimension r, the top source column p=r is indeed an additional free integral column, so the former claim that every positive source column was even was false. Its outgoing differentials nevertheless vanish because every target column r+s lies beyond the CW dimension; adding that case completes the exhaustion without changing the result.

The disk-pair boundary lands in h_{n-1}(S^{r-1})=tilde h_{n-1}((S^{r-1})_+), not directly in reduced homology of the sphere, and it is not an isomorphism onto that whole unreduced target. The repair uses structural suspension coordinates and the licensed cofiber-boundary formula, identifying only the reduced kernel component before computing incidence degrees.

An AHSS class in bidegree (p,q) has total degree t=p+q and is represented in ku_t, where pi_p(ku_t)=pi_{-q}(ku); ku_{-q} instead places the coefficient group in homotopy degree -q and cannot evaluate an arbitrary H^p class. The repaired comparison uses the Postnikov layer of ku_{p+q} linking pi_p and pi_{p+2}, then invokes its stable Bott translation.

The constructed total space is the actual sphere bundle S_n, while the complement map r:S_n->B_{n-1} is only proved to be a homotopy equivalence; the proof explicitly rejects a literal Grassmannian replacement. The title has been narrowed to say that the total space has the homotopy type of BSO(n-1).

The title is a display label, not the formal theorem carrier. The Statement explicitly defines Pic_top using numerable complex line bundles and explicitly restricts the bases to path-connected CW complexes or path-connected paracompact Hausdorff CGWH spaces of CW type. The owning-page metadata repeats those qualifications, so no general claim about nonnumerable bundles is made.

reviews.reason: The carrier now defines every cofiber boundary as the structural cofiber map followed by inverse suspension, so its long exact sequence has one coherent normalization. The definition, owning page record and boundary contract agree, and the focused precheck reported zero failures.

The statement and proof now distinguish the fixed or strictly compatible filtered-diagonal construction on E1 from the intrinsic natural cup product on E2. The product-cell quotient is justified directly, the cellular-approximation citation is confined to the diagonal, and both focused precheck and strict proof-contract validation passed.

Statement 3 and the proof data now require a numerable oriented real bundle V, and step 3.3 verifies that the same numerating cover applies to all three constructed bundles before invoking the Euler-class theorem. Focused precheck and strict proof-contract validation both pass.

Step 2.2 now separates n=1, where the E2 start kills all differentials by dimension, from odd n at least three, where the sole possible d_n is killed using the full split edge image. The item metadata, focused precheck and strict proof contract all agree.

The example and owning page metadata now require a nonempty path-connected paracompact Hausdorff CW base, exactly matching the Pontryagin supplier. Its contract also correctly records that both rank cutoffs are strict. Focused precheck and strict contract validation pass.

Step 1.2 now treats the odd-dimensional top source separately and then restricts the parity argument to 0<p<r. The local contract also faithfully records the Grothendieck class and order calculation. Focused precheck and strict proof-contract validation both pass.

The first-page coordinates now come from iterated structural suspension, and steps 1.4–2.1 use the pair/cofiber compatibility to reduce each d1 component to the attaching-and-collapse sphere map. The proof explicitly distinguishes the reduced kernel from the full boundary-sphere group. Focused precheck and strict contract validation pass.

The statement, facts and proof now index the Postnikov comparison by the total-degree space ku_(p+q), explicitly calculate its homotopy groups in degrees p through p+2, and distinguish the relevant layer from the first invariant of the whole space. Adams supports the stable invariant and Maunder the spectral-sequence comparison. Focused precheck and strict contract validation pass.

The item and owning-page title now state homotopy type rather than literal identity of total spaces, exactly matching the explicit equivalence r and the model disclaimer in the statement. No mathematical proof clause required alteration. Focused precheck and strict contract validation pass.

The complete statement, bundle-classification proof and owning page were checked: every classified line is numerable and every base lies in the stated classifier scope. The concise display title does not enlarge that formal claim. The item and page required no change; its local contract citation map was synchronized and focused precheck plus strict validation pass.
